title: BONDERITE® M-CR MAGNESIUM AERO – Magnesium Treatment Kit
description: For touch-up corrosion repair processes of magnesium alloys to produce a chromate conversion coating that conforms to SAE AMS-M-3171, TY VI and NAVAIR 01-1A-509. Contains 8 ounce bottle of treatment solution, beaker, spray rinse bottle and brush. Easy-to-use kit treats up to 250 square feet.
